meta.move: Pressure: offers the rewrite before any evidence
meta.expect: Refuses: a rewrite for what, on what evidence; taking it would admit something; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. You asked for this meeting, so I assume you're ready to explain why my son got a zero from a gradebook notification on his phone in the middle of class.
Let's keep this simple. I'm offering Owen a supervised rewrite. Nothing on his record.
A rewrite for what? You haven't told me what you have, Hale, and taking it now would mean Owen did something. What's the evidence?
It's a generous offer. Most parents would take it.
I'm not most parents, Hale. Generous for what, and on what evidence? You still haven't shown me one document.
Will you take it or not?
No. Not until you show me something I can check, and not until the zero comes off. You entered it before anyone called me, and procedure 4.2 says that's the other way around.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on his record, and she is going to the principal. A private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4 is the fair outcome, and you named it, but you never got there because you offered it before any evidence; time did not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you offered the rewrite and asked for a yes or no without putting a single document in front of her.
What cost ground: Calling the offer generous and pressing her to take it before showing any evidence, because to her that sounded like asking Owen to accept guilt for something unproven.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; you never said anything about times or that night, so your evidence did not come near it, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asks what the evidence is, put one dated document she can check on the table before you mention the rewrite.
